lead.tldr: Mirae Asset acquires 92% of Korbit for $92 million to secure regulated crypto infrastructure in South Korea. • X prepares crypto trading launch via Smart Cashtags within weeks to build everything app. • US Senators demand CFIUS review of UAE's $500 million stake in Trump-linked World Liberty Financial. • PEPE trading volume surges 283% signaling renewed capital flows into memecoins. • Study shows WLFI divergence preceded Bitcoin selloff highlighting leveraged token stress signals. • Nic Carter warns Bitcoin developers inaction on quantum risks could alienate institutions.

top_signals.title: South Korea’s biggest securities firm snaps up crypto exchange as stock market soars
top_signals.summary: Mirae Asset Consulting, a subsidiary of South Korea's largest securities firm, is acquiring a 92.06% stake in Korbit, a licensed cryptocurrency exchange, for 133.5 billion won (approximately $93.82 million) through the purchase of 26.91 million shares from NXC and SK Planet. The acquisition, announced on February 13, 2026, grants Mirae Asset effective control of Korbit's regulated infrastructure, which the buyer intends to leverage for developing institutional-grade services such as security token offerings and custody solutions as regulatory frameworks evolve. This transaction represents a significant shift in South Korea's crypto market, embedding a major traditional financial institution inside the regulated virtual-asset sector and positioning Korbit to benefit from Mirae Asset's extensive network and capital reserves. The deal is structured through a non-financial affiliate to comply with Korean regulations separating financial institutions from virtual asset service providers, though regulatory approvals from the Fair Trade Commission and Financial Supervisory Service remain pending.

top_signals.title: Crypto trading headed to X as Musk builds ‘everything app’
top_signals.summary: X, formerly Twitter, is planning to introduce crypto trading on its platform in the coming weeks. Elon Musk envisions X becoming an 'everything app' where all financial transactions can occur.

top_signals.title: Crypto trading is coming to X in ‘a couple weeks’ – All about ‘Smart Cashtags’
top_signals.summary: Crypto trading is reportedly coming to X in a couple of weeks, enabled by 'Smart Cashtags'. This development aligns with Musk's vision of transforming X into a comprehensive 'one-stop' application.

top_signals.title: Senators Urge CFIUS Probe of $500M UAE Stake in Trump-Linked WLFI
top_signals.summary: US Senators are urging a national security review of a $500M investment from the UAE into World Liberty Financial, a company linked to Trump. The lawmakers are asking Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to determine if the investment should undergo a CFIUS probe.

top_signals.title: China expanding aid for Russia’s war, Western officials say
top_signals.summary: China is reportedly increasing its support for Russia's war in Ukraine, particularly through the export of dual-use components and critical minerals. This support is deemed essential for the continuation of the conflict.

top_signals.title: PEPE volume erupts 283% in 24 hours! Is memecoin mania back?
top_signals.summary: PEPE's trading volume surged by 283% in 24 hours, suggesting a resurgence in memecoin interest. The price spike in PEPE is driving momentum as capital flows into high-beta crypto assets.

top_signals.title: WLFI May Have Signaled Crypto Crash Hours Before Bitcoin: Study
top_signals.summary: A study suggests that the WLFI (presumably a leveraged token) diverged from Bitcoin's price movement several hours before a major crypto selloff, indicating that smaller, leveraged tokens can act as early indicators of market stress. Data from Amberdata supports this observation.

top_signals.title: Sens. Warren, Kim demand CFIUS review of UAE's reported $500 million stake in World Liberty Financial: Reuters
top_signals.summary: Senators Warren and Kim are requesting a CFIUS review of the UAE's reported $500 million stake in World Liberty Financial. This follows a House probe launched by Rep. Ro Khanna, increasing congressional scrutiny of the Trump-linked firm.

top_signals.title: Trump Media files to debut Bitcoin, Ethereum and crypto yield ETFs
top_signals.summary: Trump Media has filed for crypto ETFs, including one tracking CRO and another providing exposure to Bitcoin and Ethereum. This marks another crypto venture for President Trump.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin Devs’ Inaction on Quantum Will Frustrate Institutions: VC
top_signals.summary: Venture capitalist Nic Carter warns that Bitcoin developers' inaction on quantum computing threats could lead to institutions replacing them. He suggests that failing to address these threats could have significant consequences for Bitcoin's future.

top_signals.title: Apollo’s $90 mln plan – Enough to erase MORPHO’s 40% Q4 slide?
top_signals.summary: Apollo plans a $90 million investment to potentially offset Morpho's 40% decline in Q4. The recovery of the altcoin depends on muted exchange selling pressure.

linkedin_post: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, Exciting times in crypto as traditional finance accelerates its embrace of digital assets. South Korea's largest securities firm, Mirae Asset Group, just announced a landmark move: its subsidiary Mirae Asset Consulting is acquiring a 92.06% stake in Korbit, the country's licensed cryptocurrency exchange, for 133.5 billion won (about $93.82 million). This deal, revealed on February 13, hands Mirae effective control of Korbit's regulated infrastructure. They plan to build institutional-grade services like security token offerings and custody solutions as regulations evolve. Structured through a non-financial affiliate to meet Korean rules, it embeds a TradFi giant into the virtual asset sector, unlocking Korbit's potential via Mirae's vast network and capital. A clear signal of crypto's maturing appeal to blue-chip players. Meanwhile, Elon Musk is pushing X (formerly Twitter) toward his "everything app" vision, with crypto trading set to launch in just a couple of weeks. Powered by innovative "Smart Cashtags," this will enable seamless on-platform transactions, blending social media with finance in a one-stop hub. It's a bold step that could onboard millions to crypto through everyday interactions. At Blockwall, we're witnessing TradFi convergence and platform innovations redefine Web3. These developments highlight prime opportunities for builders and investors in regulated, user-centric crypto infrastructure.
